Attempts to work around mods constructing BufferBuilder objects that leak memory. This can cause the JVM to crash with an hs_err_pid file in some rare cases. If you experience this type of crash, try disabling this option.
chinese: 尝试处理模组创建 BufferBuilder 对象时导致的内存泄漏。极少数情况下，这可能使 JVM 崩溃并生成 hs_err_pid 文件。如果遇到此类崩溃，请尝试关闭此选项。

english: Fixes the experimental feature warning being shown still being shown the first time you reopen a world that was created as experimental.
chinese: 修复重新打开最初作为实验性世界创建的存档时，首次仍然显示实验性功能警告的问题。

english: Fixes a major oversight in Forge's early error handling code that causes some parts of mods to load, but not others, which usually results in the game crashing rather than displaying the intended error screen. This issue was fixed in NeoForge, and eventually fixed in new enough versions of Forge.
chinese: 修复 Forge 早期错误处理代码中的严重疏漏：它会导致模组仅有部分内容加载，通常使游戏崩溃，无法显示预期的错误界面。NeoForge 已修复此问题，较新的 Forge 版本也已修复。

english: Hypixel sends chunks to the client that are missing some block entity data, which makes chests etc. appear invisible. This 'fixes' the problem by creating the needed data on the client. Has no effect for properly behaved servers or in singleplayer.
chinese: Hypixel 发给客户端的区块可能缺少部分方块实体数据，使箱子等对象不可见。此功能通过在客户端创建所需数据来处理该问题。对于正常运行的服务器和单人游戏，此选项没有效果。

english: Fixes MC-272431, which tracks the ender dragon being unable to dive to the portal as it did in 1.13 and older. This causes the dragon to fly quite a bit differently from what modern players are used to and also patches out one-cycling, so it's not enabled by default. Thanks to Jukitsu for identifying the regression in the vanilla code.
chinese: 修复 MC-272431：末影龙无法像 1.13 及更早版本那样俯冲到传送门。该修改会使末影龙的飞行方式发生较大变化，并使单轮击杀失效，因此默认关闭。感谢 Jukitsu 找出原版代码中的这一回归问题。

english: Fixes MC-251068, where deleting the last world takes you back to an empty world list.
chinese: 修复 MC-251068：删除最后一个世界后返回空世界列表的问题。

english: **This is a debug option and should not be enabled for regular gameplay.** Attempts to detect mods interacting with block entities on the wrong thread and crash the game with more information, rather than an unclear ConcurrentModificationException
chinese: **这是调试选项，正常游戏时应保持关闭。** 尝试检测模组在错误线程上操作方块实体的情况，并让游戏在崩溃时提供更详细的信息，帮助定位含义不明的 ConcurrentModificationException。

english: Disables the game's use of worker threads for the server and for chunk rendering. **This will make performance worse on almost all hardware**, and should only be enabled on a client, when you know exactly what you are doing, and probably only on hardware with very few (2 or less) physical CPU cores. In those rare cases, it can reduce lag spikes since there is less contention over the limited cores.
chinese: 禁止游戏为服务器运行和区块渲染使用工作线程。**这会降低几乎所有硬件上的性能**，仅应在明确理解其作用时于客户端启用，通常仅适用于物理 CPU 核心极少（2 个或更少）的硬件。在这些罕见情况下，减少对有限核心的争用可能降低卡顿峰值。

english: Runs the Forge loading screen on a background thread for part of the loading process, to allow progress to be shown while content is being registered. May have compatibility issues with some GPU drivers (e.g. macOS), so do not enable it by default in a modpack.
chinese: 在加载过程的部分阶段，使用后台线程运行 Forge 加载界面，以便注册内容时显示进度。可能与某些 GPU 驱动程序存在兼容性问题（例如 macOS），因此整合包应默认关闭此选项。

english: Prevents the Minecraft client from obtaining the keypair for chat signing. This disables the client's ability to sign chat messages (like No Chat Reports, but in a simpler, albeit less user-friendly way).
chinese: 阻止 Minecraft 客户端获取聊天签名的密钥对，从而关闭客户端为聊天消息签名的能力。其效果类似 No Chat Reports，但实现更简单，用户使用体验也较为有限。

english: Prevents the Minecraft client from sending telemetry to Mojang. The telemetry is generally not relevant to them anyway for a modded instance.
chinese: 阻止 Minecraft 客户端向 Mojang 发送遥测数据。对于安装模组的游戏实例，这些遥测数据通常也缺乏参考意义。

english: Prevents the game from logging a very long stacktrace when the narrator fails to load on Linux (usually caused by not having libflite installed).
chinese: 防止 Linux 上的朗读器加载失败时，在日志中输出冗长的堆栈跟踪。该问题通常由缺少 libflite 引起。

english: Implements some minor optimizations to the vanilla chunk meshing logic (they will have no effect with a mod that replaces chunk rendering entirely).
chinese: 对原版区块网格生成逻辑进行少量优化。完全替换区块渲染的模组存在时，这些优化不会生效。

english: Stores the glyphs for the Unicode font more efficiently. Kudos to @AnAwesomGuy for the trick.
chinese: 使用更高效的方式存储 Unicode 字体的字形。感谢 @AnAwesomGuy 提供这一方法。

english: LDLib compatibility patch for dynamic resources
chinese: 动态资源的 LDLib 兼容性补丁

english: Improves the speed at which structures like buried treasure can be located.
chinese: 提高定位埋藏的宝藏等结构的速度。

english: Fixes more oversights in Forge that lead to excessive allocation in hot registry methods.
chinese: 修复 Forge 中导致高频调用的注册表方法分配过多内存对象的其他疏漏。

english: Improves on vanilla's existing caching for creative tab contents in a way that is compatible with the timing requirements of mods like JEI/EMI. This can reduce the lag spike when opening the creative inventory for the first time in a modpack.
chinese: 改进原版对创造模式物品栏内容的缓存，并兼容 JEI、EMI 等模组的时序要求。这可以减轻整合包中首次打开创造模式物品栏时的卡顿。

english: Optimizes the Forge event for finding potential mobs that can spawn. This reduces allocations and the overhead of rebuilding a weighted list when no mods modify the potential spawns.
chinese: 优化 Forge 查找潜在生成生物的事件。当没有模组修改潜在生成列表时，减少内存对象分配和重建加权列表的开销。

english: Optimizes chunk ticking in vanilla to reduce allocations.
chinese: 优化原版区块更新逻辑，减少内存对象分配。

english: Optimizes some world generation logic in vanilla to reduce object allocations.
chinese: 优化部分原版世界生成逻辑，减少内存对象分配。

english: ModernFix detected that Redirector is installed. Redirector is known to cause many strange and hard-to-debug issues, and removing it is strongly recommended.
chinese: ModernFix 检测到已安装 Redirector。Redirector 已知会引发多种异常且难以调试的问题，强烈建议移除。
